name: Dr. Bibekananda Mohanty
title: Skill Development Trainer
bio: Dr. Bibekananda Mohanty is a seasoned management professional with over 28 years of combined experience spanning Corporate and Higher Education. Holding a Ph.D. in Management, he possesses extensive expertise in sales and marketing management, academic leadership, quality assurance, and institutional development. His professional journey includes leadership roles in reputed organizations and more than 16 years of teaching and administrative experience in management education. He has successfully coordinated accreditation initiatives, faculty development programs, student mentoring activities, and industry-academia collaborations. An accomplished researcher with publications in Scopus and ABDC-indexed journals, Dr. Mohanty specializes in Marketing Management, Sales & Distribution Management, and Organizational Behaviour, combining industry insights with academic excellence to drive organizational growth and innovation.
